correctness.rationale: The stationary Markov generator closes degree-one and degree-three polynomials. Its exact semigroup gives the chronological difference; the identity 1-Q^4-2Q+2Q^3=(1-Q)^3(1+Q)>0 proves strict all-lag sign for all |Q|<1. Positivity and exactly one maximum follow from an integral of two exponentials. Independent polynomial matrix-semigroup verification passed 520 cases; finite tests corroborate the proof.

value.rationale: Provides a distribution-independent direction of a fourth-order chronological observable for arbitrary signed random reset multipliers, with exact optimal measurement lag and invariance to independent reversible colored or non-Gaussian noise. This is a structural nonequilibrium diagnostic not apparent from stationary marginals and stronger than a single parameter substitution.
